Containers.Name: Enhanced Log v3
Containers.Description: This plugin enhances the built-in Syslog page to view the system log with highlighted lines. You can enable or disable event highlighting and set your own colors for each event. You can add your own search string to highlight in the log. Successor to Enhanced Log v2 by Derek Kaser (dkaser), which is based on the original Enhanced Log by Dan Landon (dlandon). Installing it copies the settings of the old plugin and removes it.
